about: The recognition test's frozen definitions (docs/TRAINING.md, 'The recognition test'). Read-only measurement: nothing that decides reads this file or the tool; the model is asked nothing. cases: the frozen case list (config/recognition-cases.json), refused unless its bytes hash to casesSha256. margins: the matching rule's maximum delay in candles per case kind, frozen before any model run (every case's own margin must equal its kind's). sharpMaxCandles: a census leg spanning at most this many candles is 'sharp', else 'slow'. chopLabel: the bars-only chop label v2 (window, the eligible bar count, the net move ceiling and range floor in ATR, the ATR length). signals: the chop-class signals' session VWAP crosses thresholds (C7 chop at or above crossesChop; T6 trend at or below crossesTrendMax with price on the side's side of VWAP). A changed value needs a new version and a reason in the pull request.
